issues.title: Unresolved External Dependency: Coding Guidelines
issues.why: AC-SD-01 and AC-SD-24 explicitly delegate core naming and typing rules to a relative path (../02-coding-guidelines/...) not provided in this context.
issues.fix: Provide the content of spec/02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/97-acceptance-criteria.md in the audit context.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency Strategy for Migrations
issues.why: AC-SD-07 mandates independent migrations but does not specify how to handle file-level locks if a migration and a query occur simultaneously across processes.
issues.fix: Add a clause to AC-SD-07 requiring migrations to use the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE + retry logic defined in AC-SD-22.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'ApplicationId' Source in Counter Table
issues.why: AC-SD-05 and the SQL in 02-features/01-cli-examples.md reference ApplicationId, but the Root DB schema in 01-fundamentals.md uses ProjectId.
issues.fix: Standardize on 'ProjectId' across all fundamentals and feature examples to match the Root DB schema.
